name: Fiddlesticks
notes: Fiddlesticks is played as a pure caster here: his damage is entirely abilities, so attack.never is set and items keyed on basic attacks (on-hit, attack speed, resets) get no value.

The opening cast is Crowstorm: it channels 1.5 s, then blinks in and ticks every 0.25 s for 5 s (20 ticks); Fiddlesticks is free to cast Q/W/E during the 5 s tick window but not during the 1.5 s channel.

Terrify's crow travel time (0.35 s) is folded into its cast: the damage is applied at the moment of cast (as the reference driver does for other champions' short travel times) but the 0.35 s still occupies Fiddlesticks and blocks starting another ability during it.

Terrify's feared-target double-damage bonus is not modeled: it requires the target to already be 'recently feared', which itself requires Fiddlesticks to be unseen/out of combat when the fear-applying ability lands. Once Fiddlesticks casts anything it is in combat for the rest of the fight, so this never lines up again in a continuous damage-fight rotation; Terrify always deals its single (non-doubled) damage here, and this is a deliberate simplification, not an oversight.
Terrify's damage cap (400) only applies against monsters; the dummy counts as a champion, so it is not capped.

Bountiful Harvest channels its full 2 s uninterrupted against the stationary dummy (8 ticks of 0.25 s); the last tick adds bonus damage from the dummy's missing health, and completing the channel refunds 60% of the remaining cooldown.
Reap's damage lands at the end of its 0.4 s cast; hitting the center for the silence has no damage effect and is not modeled.
Crowstorm's cooldown starts at the moment of cast (its channel), per the ability's own cdstart flag.
When free to act, the rotation priority is Crowstorm > Bountiful Harvest > Reap, with Terrify woven in automatically whenever it is off cooldown and Fiddlesticks isn't mid-cast of something else.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing in this rotation is expected to bind on mana within a 15 s window at level 16.

assumed.why: the wiki states Crowstorm deals damage every 0.25 s but Riot's bin has no explicit tick-interval field for it (only the per-tick damage formula implies the 0.25 s multiplier)
